title: fix(pm): six card readings move from domain:* to area:* and the epic parent

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuR8F5nRQPQ47C5tRSxaHjFv)_

Fixes #35234
Fixes #35613

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Changeset: none, labelled `skip-changeset`. The diff touches four fleet scripts under `scripts/pm/`, and no published package moves.
Seat: repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWh7NM35xq2HajeYCx

No script under `scripts/pm/` judges a card by its `domain:*` label any more. The six readings of the first round, plus H38's claim index and H39's census in the second round, all read the card's intake. The one `domain:*` reading left is a printed column (`card-pick.mjs` `domainOf`), and it judges nothing.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;车队内部的巡查、待审清单和席位名册改为按「区」和所属专题判断一张卡归哪个席位,旧的「领域」标签单独不再决定归属。
- 为什么做:落实已商定的「席位加专题」新排班,替换掉还在按退役领域席位分卡的八处判断,为撤掉领域标签扫清路。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是巡查漏提醒或错提醒某张卡该由哪个席位接,只影响内部派单、不碰产品;直接撤回这次合并即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:合并后另行确认是否撤除领域标签;脚本已不再依赖它们,撤除前要一并处理的几件事见下文清单。

## The `domain:*` label retirement, for the maintainer

This pull retires and deletes no label. The retirement is the separate step the card reserves for you. No script reading blocks it any more. These things go with it:

- The vacant `domain:*` seat posts (for example `domain:spec · seat 3`) still show as roster rows, with empty card columns, until they are retitled or closed. `fleet-roster.mjs` now gives such a row no card.
- `ensure-pm-labels.sh` still creates the `domain:*` labels. Retiring them means removing them there as well.
- `LANE_LABEL_ALIASES` in `check-half-states.mjs`, and the write doors that rewrite a retired `domain:*` spelling when they write a label, go when the labels go. Their only reader left is a seat post's title.
- `card-pick.mjs` `domainOf` is left alone on purpose. It is a printed column that judges nothing, and `card-pick.mjs` belongs to #35237, which is in development. Its unread-legs note still tells a seat to read each row's `domain:*`, and that note moves with that card.

## What changes

| Reading | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| H71 `h71UnclaimedOnDutyLane` | a queued card's `domain:*` label against the domain lanes of on-duty seats | the card's intake (`area:*` labels, plus `epic:#N` when its REST `parent_issue_url` is an issue on this board) against the intake keys a 🟢 seat post's title names |
| H32 lane inventory (`sweepInto`) and `h32SeatIdleOverQueue` | the seat's domain lane, counted over cards carrying that `domain:*` label | the seat's intake, counted over cards whose intake meets it (`seatIntakeInventory`), each card once |
| H73 `h73RuledCardStillInBox` | named the owing seat by the card's `domain:*` label | names the seat whose post names the card's `area:*` labels or its epic parent. The epic is said, never numbered. A card with neither goes to triage. |
| H74 `h74InheritsFromParent` | a sub-issue inheriting its parent's `domain:*` or grade was exempt | inheriting the parent's `area:*` or grade is exempt. A `domain:*` label alone no longer exempts. |
| `check-owed-reviews.mjs` lane seat (`laneSeatOf`) | the card's `domain:*` label against seat lanes | the card's intake against each seat's `intake` (read from its post title). The snapshot carries the card's `parent_issue_url`. |
| `fleet-roster.mjs` `cardLaneMatch` | a `domain:x` seat row owned the cards labelled `domain:x` | a `domain:x` row owns no card. A `repo:x` seat owns its repo's cards by account, as before. |
| H38 `newestLaneClaim` and `h38SeatPostStale` (and the `sweepInto` caller) | the seat's `domain:*` lane, through the alias map, against a dispatched card's `domain:*` label | the seat post's `seatIntakeKeys` against the card's `cardIntakeKeys`. A post whose title names no intake on this board (a retired domain seat, a sibling board's lane, triage) takes no row. The finding names the intake. |
| H39 `censusLanesOf` | a closed card bucketed by its `domain:*` (alias-resolved) and `repo:*` labels | bucketed by its intake (`area:*`, a same-board `epic:#N`) and `repo:*`. A `domain:*` label alone is `(no lane)`. |
| `ensure-pm-labels.sh` comment | said disjunct ③ and H13 read `domain:*` | says they read `area:*` (the first half of the card moved them) |

There are two new pure helpers in `check-half-states.mjs`, and the other scripts import them. `seatIntakeKeys(post)` reads the `area:x` tokens and `epic #N` / `epic:#N` off a seat title. It returns them only for a lane on this board: a `repo:` lane of another repo, a `@ elsewhere` suffix, a `domain:*` seat and an unparseable title all give no intake. `cardIntakeKeys(card)` reads the card's `area:*` labels plus `epic:#N` from a same-repo `parent_issue_url`. `parent_issue_url` is on the REST issue row, so the epic reading costs no extra request.

`seatLane` stays: it gives the seat number off any title, and it reads a `domain:*` seat title through the alias map. `h32NeedsSeatComments` keeps its domain leg, which only keeps a retired domain seat's thread read (H44 reads it anyway) and judges no card. H32 and H38 both skip such a post, since it names no intake.

### Rounds 3–4: the claim's seat number reads today's seat spellings

- `CLAIM_SEAT_DECLARATION_ANYWHERE` (the mid-line `Seat:` presence probe behind `claimSeatNumber`) now recognises every seat spelling live on the board: `repo:NAME#N` (dots and dashes allowed, e.g. `repo:www.objectos.ai#2`), `epic:#N#K`, and the retired `domain:LANE#N`. It still demands the whole payload and is still case-sensitive. Before, a mid-line `Seat: repo:objectstack#3` read as seat 1, so H38 could flag a seat-1 post as stale over another seat's claim. Now that declaration reads as unreadable and matches no seat.
- `claimSeatNumber` reads a line-initial `epic:#N#K` payload (optionally backticked) as seat K, not the epic number N; before, `Seat: epic:#31527#1` read as seat 31527 and matched no seat. Every other spelling still takes the first `#digits`, so a trailing note never changes the answer.

### Round 5: the sweep's ③ counts `pm:epic` as a state (#35613), and H74's wording

- First-touch sweep ③ (「`area:*` 无 pm-state」) counts `pm:epic` as a state, as H13 does for the same phrase. An epic card with an area and a grade but no dispatch position is no longer FOUND on every fire. The type row and the area backstop row are unchanged.
- H74: the coverage sentence now says a sub-issue inherits its parent's area or grade (it said `domain or grade`). The branch merged `main` once after #35532 landed (merge 7d2be2b4, no conflict).

## Tests

Every changed behaviour has a self-test case. Battery pins were moved to the new counts, with a comment on each move:

- `check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: 5356 → 5378 cases, exit 0 (round one 5369, round two adds nine: H38 two post scopes and five intake cases, H39 two lane cases). In the `domain:server lane aliases` battery, the five claim-index and two census cases were rewritten in place to pin that a `domain:*` label, in any spelling, is on no intake. The count did not change, so that pin did not move. Pins: `H70/H71 seat patrol` 30 → 35, `H73 ruled card in the decision box` 25 → 26. `H74` stays at 46. It still registers more than that, and leaving the pin line alone keeps it clear of the other open pull's edit there.
- `check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`: 91 → 94 cases, exit 0. The triggers pin moved 10 → 13.
- `fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`: 116 cases in 9 batteries → 118 in 10, exit 0. The fixture battery dropped 29 → 24: nine domain-ownership cases became four cases that pin a domain row owning nothing. A new battery (7) shows a `repo:` seat owning cards by account for in flight, landing, merge and rulings. The battery floor moved 9 → 10.

Each new reading has one ablation, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each one reverts the reading to `domain:*`, runs the battery, and restores. Every one went red, and every restore proved the blob equals HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- Rounds 3–4 (head c8a8b2c2): eight pins beside the H38 seat rows. Mid-line `repo:` and `epic:#31527#1` declarations read null; line-initial `Seat: repo:objectstack#3` reads 3; the prose control `the seat: repo:objectstack#2 is busy` still reads 1; `Seat: epic:#31527#1` reads 1, backticked `epic:#31527#2` reads 2, and an epic line and a repo line each ending in `(filed under #35205)` read 1 and 3. `check-half-states.mjs --self-test` passes 5386 cases, exit 0. Ablation 10 (regex back to the domain-only payload): 2 of 5382 failed, exit 1. Ablation 11 (epic branch deleted): 3 of 5386 failed, exit 1. Each restore was proven by blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- Round 5 (#35613, head 560644f7): two classifier cases. `area:fleet` + `pm:epic` + `priority:p1` draws no ③ row, and the same card without `pm:epic` still draws ③; the battery pin moves 20 → 22. `first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test` passes 69 cases, `check-half-states.mjs --self-test` 5389, both exit 0. Ablation 12 removes the `pm:epic` term: 1 of 69 failed, exit 1; restore proven by blob == HEAD. A live read-only sweep at 17:42Z no longer lists #34571, #35547 or #35590 under ③.

<details><summary>Ablation readings (1–6 on head 0e19c38e, 7–9 on head a00496a2)</summary>

| # | Reading reverted | Battery | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | H71 card lanes ← `domain:*` labels | check-half-states | 7 of 5369 failed, exit 1 |
| 2 | H32 inventory ← `domain:*` labels | check-half-states | 2 of 5369 failed, exit 1 |
| 2b | H32 seat gate dropped (no-intake seat admitted) | check-half-states | 3 of 5369 failed, exit 1 |
| 3 | H73 intake ← `domain:*` labels | check-half-states | 3 of 5369 failed, exit 1 |
| 4 | H74 inherits `domain:` instead of `area:` | check-half-states | 2 of 5369 failed, exit 1 |
| 5 | `laneSeatOf` ← seat lane against card label | check-owed-reviews | 27 of 94 failed, exit 1 |
| 6 | `cardLaneMatch` domain branch re-added | fleet-roster | 3 failures, exit 1 |
| 7 | H38 `newestLaneClaim` card match back to its alias-resolved labels | check-half-states | red, exit 1: the first affected case throws (null `.number`) |
| 8 | H38 `h38SeatPostStale` back to the `seatLane` domain lane | check-half-states | 11 of 5378 failed, exit 1 |
| 9 | H39 `censusLanesOf` back to `domain:`/`repo:` labels | check-half-states | red, exit 1: the first affected case throws (undefined lane row) |

The first attempt at 6 was a no-op: its replacement still contained the anchor, so the tool refused it before running anything. It was rerun with an anchor the replacement does not contain. 7 and 9 went red by a TypeError in the first case that reads the reverted value, not by a counted failure. The battery exits 1 either way. Every restore line reads `ok restored: blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD is empty`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/scripts/__tests__/cross-file-line-citation-census.test.ts` is the only test that names these scripts. It uses `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` as a path string in a fixture and does not exercise the script, so it is not owed here.
- objectui seat posts could not be read from this session (403), so they were not checked against the new rule that a domain row owns no card. objectui now lives in the `ui/` tree, so the risk is low.
- A claim's `Seat:` declaration carried mid-line is read as unreadable only when it spells a `domain:*` seat (`CLAIM_SEAT_DECLARATION_ANYWHERE`). A mid-line `Seat: repo:objectstack#3` reads as seat 1 (`claimSeatNumber` gives 1; the `domain:spec#3` control gives null). This reads claim text, not a card's labels. It was left out of this pull and is reported to the seat.
- H74's wording on one line (the sentence that describes a sub-issue inheriting its parent's grade) still says "domain or grade". Changing it collides with the other open pull that edits next to H74, so it was left for that pull or the follow-up.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: `seatIntakeKeys` / `cardIntakeKeys` / `seatIntakeInventory` (after `seatLane`), then H71 and the `sweepInto` hunk that builds `onDutyLanes`.
2. `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`: `laneSeatOf` and the `readSnapshot` hunk that adds `intake` and `cardParent`.
3. `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`: `cardLaneMatch` and the new repo-lane battery.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`. Expect three success lines, with 5378, 94 and 118 cases.
